findings.title: A shift cover earned while the cover bank is full is recorded as granted and lost if a cover is spent later in the same week
findings.problem: `maybeGrantCover` adds the Monday week to `coverWeeks` even when `rewards.covers` is already `MAX_COVERS`, so `covers` does not increase and `granted` is false. If the student later spends a cover in that same week, a subsequent call to `maybeGrantCover` sees `coverWeeks.includes(wk.monday)` and returns without granting. The cover the student earned is therefore silently lost.
findings.failure_scenario: State: `rewards.covers = 2`, `coverWeeks = []`, and the current week has 5 qualifying study days. `maybeGrantCover` returns `{ covers: 2, coverWeeks: [monday], granted: false }`. The student then misses a day, `advanceStreak` consumes one cover, leaving `covers = 1`. Later in the same week `maybeGrantCover` sees the already-recorded Monday and returns without granting, so the expected banked cover never appears.
findings.fix: Only add `wk.monday` to `coverWeeks` when a cover is actually banked (`rewards.covers < MAX_COVERS`). If at cap, leave the week unmarked so the cover can be earned if capacity opens later in the same week, or explicitly document and render for users that covers over the cap are discarded at the moment they are earned.

findings.title: Removed protected rank/XP card
findings.problem: The 'RANK Student Nurse' card with '80 XP to New Grad - best answer run 0' is removed, violating the protected XP/ranks feature.
findings.failure_scenario: Students lose visibility of their rank and XP progress, a core protected feature.
findings.fix: Restore the rank/XP card or an equivalent progress indicator.

findings.title: Stub section
findings.problem: The 'CLINICAL CAREER' heading appears with no content, which is a stub/placeholder.
findings.failure_scenario: The dashboard shows an empty section, confusing students and violating the no-placeholders rule.
findings.fix: Remove the empty heading or populate it with real content.

findings.title: Ambiguous badge text
findings.problem: The 'Day 0 - 7 to 7' badge is ambiguous and potentially misleading.
findings.failure_scenario: Students may not understand the meaning of the '7 to 7' time range in a study context.
findings.fix: Clarify the badge text (e.g., use a clear date or remove the time range).

assessment:
Text pass: One real reward-accounting edge exists, but no blocker or major defect was found in the clinical content, scoring math, persistence safety, or adversarial-gate wiring.

Picture pass: The after today-dashboard screenshot has two major defects: it removes the protected 'RANK Student Nurse' XP card and shows an empty 'CLINICAL CAREER' heading. It also has a minor ambiguous 'Day 0 - 7 to 7' badge. The adaptive-practice and lab-reference screenshots are unchanged.
